Test it returns why plus the re-arm instruction. Auto-off re-arms on ticking the box (existing).

Run node scripts/aibridge/tests/handsfree.test.js and node scripts/aibridge/tests/loop.test.js (both green), then python scripts/dev/run_all_tests.py --quick. Mark B196 FIXED in research/BUGS.md and items/INDEX.md only if CI is green. Do NOT install the extension; ask for a desk task to install.
